Reuters (approved wire). Date/time confirmed inside article text: "Sept 30 (Reuters)" and carrier timestamp "30 September, 2026 08:30 am IST". Search highlights only (not a full fetch). WARNING: no approved-domain URL located for this Reuters copy — do NOT hyperlink to the carrier.

Sept 30 (Reuters) - Russian air strikes killed a child and injured another five people in the Ukrainian capital of Kyiv and the surrounding region early on Wednesday, officials said.

Fires broke out, affecting private houses along with a store and a warehouse in Kyiv and leaving two people injured, Mayor Vitali Klitschko said on Telegram. A Reuters witness heard explosions in the city.

Tymur Tkachenko, Kyiv regional governor, writing on Telegram, said that a Russian missile and a drone strike killed a child and injured three more people in the area, also damaging infrastructure facilities, houses, warehouses and cars.

(Reporting by Jekaterina Golubkova in Tokyo; Editing by Jacqueline Wong)

[FIGURES ARE MOVING. Reuters early copy: 1 killed (a child), 5 injured. Later Ukrainian official figures (Kyiv City Military Administration, via non-approved Ukrainian outlets): 2 killed and 4 injured in Kyiv city, plus the child killed in Vyshhorod in Kyiv Oblast = 3 dead in total. Kyiv City Military Administration and Kyiv Oblast head Tymur Tkachenko are the primary sources. Tkachenko, on Telegram: "Rescue workers have pulled three people from under the rubble of a destroyed house in Vyshhorod. One of them is a child who is suffering from shock. A man has sustained shrapnel wounds to the head, while a woman suffered a leg injury... Sadly, the body of a child has been found under the rubble. Rescue workers are working to clear the rubble. This is a terrible tragedy." Treat any figure above the Reuters 1 dead / 5 injured as provisional.]
